entries.title: Proverbs 17:1
segments: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, Than a house full of feasting with strife.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:2
segments: A servant that dealeth wisely shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, And shall have part in the inheritance among the brethren.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:3
segments: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; But Jehovah trieth the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:4
segments: An evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; [And] a liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:5
segments: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker; [And] he that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:6
segments: Children's children are the crown of old men; And the glory of children are their fathers.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:7
segments: Excellent speech becometh not a fool; Much less do lying lips a prince.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:8
segments: A bribe is [as] a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it; Whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:9
segments: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that harpeth on a matter separateth chief friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:10
segments: A rebuke entereth deeper into one that hath understanding Than a hundred stripes into a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:11
segments: An evil man seeketh only rebellion; Therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:12
segments: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:13
segments: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, Evil shall not depart from his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:14
segments: The beginning of strife is [as] when one letteth out water: Therefore leave off contention, before there is quarrelling.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:15
segments: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, Both of them alike are an abomination to Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:16
segments: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, Seeing he hath no understanding?

entries.title: Proverbs 17:17
segments: A friend loveth at all times; And a brother is born for adversity.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:18
segments: A man void of understanding striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his neighbor.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:19
segments: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: He that raiseth high his gate seeketh destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:20
segments: He that hath a wayward heart findeth no good; And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:21
segments: He that begetteth a fool [doeth it] to his sorrow; And the father of a fool hath no joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:22
segments: A cheerful heart is a good medicine; But a broken spirit drieth up the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:23
segments: A wicked man receiveth a bribe out of the bosom, To pervert the ways of justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:24
segments: Wisdom is before the face of him that hath understanding; But the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:25
segments: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her that bare him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:26
segments: Also to punish the righteous is not good, [Nor] to smite the noble for [their] uprightness.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:27
segments: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; And he that is of a cool spirit is a man of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:28
segments: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; When he shutteth his lips, he is [esteemed as] prudent.
